rule: RIM->AVB 4 chemical edges sign +1->-1; topology/weights unchanged
basis: Pirri et al. 2009 Neuron (PMC2804440): RIM tyramine -> LGC-55 chloride channel on AVB; AVB-specific rescue restores backward duration -> functional polarity = inhibition
Pirri & Alkema 2011: tyraminergic LGC-55 hyperpolarises AVB, biasing the bistable circuit toward the backward state
Sordillo & Bargmann 2021 eLife 10:e67723: RIM->AVA is excitatory (AMPA), kept at +1
Meng 2024 (PMC11006214) master neuron: AVA has no direct anatomical output to AVB; the phasic inhibition is indirect/extrasynaptic -> RIM/LGC-55 is the candidate carrier
note: Same class as M2c/M5d: a polarity correction from functional electrophysiology evidence, not a topology change; the EM anatomical edges themselves are kept (Cook 2019), only the net functional sign is corrected.
